_comment: The new WSL distribution's additions to adoption/mcp/claude-user.json. Only tools/adoption/new_wsl_client_config.py reads this file: it merges the servers below into the shared template (a server both files name is refused) and wires each through adoption/new-wsl/client-config-map.json, so the shared template stays what install_claude_profile.py registers on every other host. semble 0.6.1 is the code-search slot's interim install there (definitive manifest, amendment 3; wave-2 code-search ruling, changes 4 and 5): the uv tool's `semble` console script, with the pinned model's local snapshot as SEMBLE_MODEL_NAME and Claude Code's own absolute SEMBLE_CACHE_LOCATION (Codex's entry, in codex.config.additions.toml beside this file, names semble-codex): a cache shared by two processes can keep serving an index another process rebuilt. promptfoo is the manifest's promptfoo slot (pinned Promptfoo 0.123.1; the first host runs 0.124.0): `promptfoo mcp --transport stdio` from the installed global package, with the distribution's own state directory and telemetry and the update check off (docs/decisions/2026-10-12-mcp-template-live-reconciliation.md). Changed 2026-10-12: semble leaves this file with the other code-navigation servers of the Claude user-scope profile; its entry, unchanged, is in adoption/mcp/claude-code-navigation.json (the on-demand set), and the Claude allow rules for its two tools stay in claude.settings.additions.json, inert while the server is not loaded (docs/decisions/2026-10-12-code-navigation-on-demand.md). The Codex entry beside this file is unchanged.
